CHAPTER.CAPTION: Psalm of David
CHAPTER.VERS: I have taken refuge in you, O Jehovah. Never let me be put to shame. Deliver me because of your righteousness.
Turn your ear toward me. Rescue me quickly. Be a rock of refuge for me, a stronghold fortress to save me.
You are my rock and my stronghold. For the sake of your name, lead me and guide me.
You are my refuge. Pull me out of the net that they have secretly laid for me.
Into your hands I entrust my spirit. You have redeemed me, O Jehovah, God of truth.
I hate those who cling to false gods, but I do trust in Jehovah.
I will rejoice and be glad because of your loving-kindness . You have seen my misery. You have known my troubles.
You have not handed me over to the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
Be gracious to me, O Jehovah, because I am in distress. My eyes, my life, and my body waste away with grief.
My life is spent from sorrow, my years from groaning. My strength staggers under the weight of my guilt, and my bones waste away.
I have become a disgrace because of all my opponents. I have become someone dreaded by my friends, even by my neighbors. Those who see me on the street run away from me.
I have faded from memory as if I were dead and have become like a piece of broken pottery.
I have heard the whispering of many people, terror on every side, while they made plans together against me. They were plotting to take my life.
I trust you, O Jehovah. I said: »You are my God.«
My future is in your hands. Rescue me from my enemies, from those who persecute me.

Make your face shine on me
. Save me in your loving-kindness.
O Jehovah, I have called on you, so do not let me be put to shame. Let wicked people be put to shame. Let them be silent in the grave.
Let their lying lips be speechless, since they speak against righteous people with arrogance and contempt.
Your goodness is so great! You reserve it for those who respect you. The sons of men watch as you show it to those who take refuge in you.
You hide them in the secret place of your presence from those who scheme against them. You keep them in a secret shelter, safe from quarrelsome tongues.
Blessed is Jehovah! He has shown me the miracle of his loving-kindness in a city under attack.
When I was panic-stricken, I said: I have been cut off from your sight. But you heard my pleas for mercy when I cried out to you for help.
Love Jehovah, all you godly ones! Jehovah protects faithful people, but he pays back in full those who act arrogantly.
Be strong, all who wait with hope for Jehovah, and let your heart be courageous.
